paper.title: Bilateral Trade Under Heavy-Tailed Valuations: Minimax Regret without a Variance Bound

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bilateral trade, parametric (linear) market value, full feedback, heavy-tailed valuations (known parameters)
unmapped: Bilateral trade (brokerage) gain g(p,v,w) = (v∨w − v∧w)·1{v∧w ≤ p ≤ v∨w}; action is a posted price
Full feedback means both trader valuations V_t, W_t are observed (action-independent observations)
Valuations V_t = m(x_t)+xi_t, W_t = m(x_t)+zeta_t with conditionally independent, conditionally centered noise with conditional densities bounded by L
Market value m(x) = x^T phi linear in context, ||phi|| <= B, ||x_t|| <= 1, E[x x^T] >= lambda I
Conditional p-th moment of noise bounded by sigma_p^p, p in (1,2)
settings.definition_quote: Over $T$ rounds, at round $t$: a context $x_t \in \mathcal{X} \subset \R^d$ is revealed; two traders arrive with valuations $V_t = m(x_t) + \xi_t$ and $W_t = m(x_t) + \zeta_t$; the broker posts price $P_t$ and observes $(V_t, W_t)$ (full feedback). ... regret is $R_T = \sum_{t=1}^T \E[g(m(x_t), V_t, W_t) - g(P_t, V_t, W_t)]$.

source.label: thm:parametric
source.quote: Let $m(x) = x^\top \phi$, $\phi \in \R^d$ with $\|\phi\| \le B$ for a known bound $B > 0$. Under Assumptions~\ref{ass:density}--\ref{ass:moment} with full feedback, assuming $x_t$ are i.i.d.\ with $\|x_t\| \le 1$ a.s.\ and $\Sigma := \E[x_t x_t^\top] \succeq \lambda I_d$ for some $\lambda > 0$: the epoch algorithm ... achieves $R_T = \Otil\!\left(L\, d\, (B + \sigma_p)^2\, \lambda^{-2}\, T^{(2-p)/p}\right)$

results.notes: Regret compares to the per-context optimal price m(x_t) in expectation (pseudo-regret style). Leading coefficient 196 L d (B+sigma_p)^2/lambda^2 per proof. Bilateral trade with action-independent (full) feedback.

source.label: prop:lower
source.quote: Fix parameters as in Theorem~\ref{thm:nonparametric} with $\beta \in (0,1]$ ..., and assume the mild nondegeneracy $(2L\sigma_p)^p \ge 8$. Then for every nonanticipating algorithm there are instances satisfying Assumptions~\ref{ass:density}--\ref{ass:regular} with these parameters on which $R_T = \Omega\!\left(T^{\;1 - 2\beta(p-1)/(\beta p + d(p-1))}\right).$

results.notes: Assouad + fixed-support mixture construction. Matches upper bound in T up to logs.

source.label: prop:paramlower
source.quote: Fix $p \in (1,2)$, $L \ge 1$, $\sigma_p$ with $(2L\sigma_p)^p \ge 8$, and $B > 0$. For $d = 1$, every nonanticipating algorithm admits instances of the parametric model ... on which, for all $T$ large enough ..., $R_T \ge c(p)\,L\,\sigma_p^2\,T^{(2-p)/p}, \quad c(p) > 0.$ For fixed $d \ge 2$ the same $T$-rate holds with constants depending on $d$.

results.notes: c(p) = (3/32)(16 kappa_p)^{-2(p-1)/p} with kappa_p = 8*4^{1/(p-1)}. For d >= 2, proof gives Omega_d(L sigma_p^2 (T/d)^{(2-p)/p}) with lambda = 1/d; dimension dependence left open.
